purpose: Define bounded listener lifecycle from declaration through enable/start/running/stop/reload/failure with deterministic cleanup and no conflation of config state with runtime state.

topics.name: Listener Lifecycle
topics.purpose: Define bounded listener lifecycle from declaration through enable/start/running/stop/reload/failure with deterministic cleanup and no conflation of config state with runtime state.

semantics.start_rule: Start uses the current validated listener definition/binding.
semantics.stop_rule: Stop releases socket/process/session resources without deleting listener definition.
semantics.reload_rule: Reload validates candidate config before rebinding/restarting where required.
semantics.failure_rule: Bind/start/runtime failure is explicit and does not silently change identity or port.
semantics.cleanup_rule: All terminal paths release owned listener resources.
semantics.config_rule: Enabled/declared configuration and current running state remain distinguishable.
semantics.authority_rule: Starting/stopping listener requires explicit lifecycle authority.

invariants.rule: Listener/service identity is stable and separate from mutable listen binding, protocol configuration and runtime process/session state.

hard_gates.condition: failed bind silently chooses another port

references.purpose: Listener reload follows validated reconciliation semantics.
